import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter
AA="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
B62="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3

0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
-1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
SM=np.array([[float(x) for x in r.split()] for r in B62.strip().split("\n")]); IDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}
def onehot(s):
    m=np.zeros((len(s),20))
    for i,c in enumerate(s):
        if c in IDX: m[i,IDX[c]]=1.0
    return m
NEG=-1e9; GOp=-11.0; GEp=-1.0
def align(sa,sb):
    pa,pb=onehot(sa),onehot(sb); n,m=len(sa),len(sb); SC=pa@SM@pb.T
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    Tm=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); Tx=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); Ky=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int32)
    M[0,0]=0.0; j=np.arange(m+1); Iy[0,1:]=GOp+GEp*(np.arange(1,m+1)-1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        st=np.vstack([M[i-1]+GOp,Ix[i-1]+GEp,Iy[i-1]+GOp]); Ix[i]=st.max(0); Tx[i]=st.argmax(0).astype(np.int8)
        d=np.vstack([M[i-1,:-1],Ix[i-1,:-1],Iy[i-1,:-1]]); M[i,1:]=d.max(0)+SC[i-1]
        Tm[i,1:]=d.argmax(0).astype(np.int8); M[i,0]=NEG
        best=np.maximum(M[i],Ix[i]); u=best-GEp*j; run=np.maximum.accumulate(u)
        pidx=np.maximum.accumulate(np.where(u>=run,j,-1)); Iy[i,1:]=run[:-1]+GOp+GEp*(j[1:]-1); Ky[i,1:]=pidx[:-1]
    i,jj=n,m; state=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); mp={}
    while i>0 or jj>0:
        if state==0: mp[i-1]=jj-1; s=Tm[i,jj]; i-=1; jj-=1; state=int(s)
        elif state==1: s=Tx[i,jj]; i-=1; state=int(s)
        else:
            k=int(Ky[i,jj]); jj=k
            state=int(np.argmax([M[i,jj],Ix[i,jj],NEG])) if (i>0 or jj>0) else 0
            if i==0 and jj>0: jj=0
        if i<0 or jj<0: break
    return mp
def fasta(q):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",params={"query":q,"format":"fasta"},timeout=90)
    out={};cur=None
    for l in r.text.split("\n"):
        if l.startswith(">"): cur=l[1:].split()[0]; out[cur]=""
        elif cur and l.strip(): out[cur]+=l.strip()
    return out
sp_set=fasta("(xref:pfam-PF13813) AND (taxonomy_id:4895)")
fu_set=fasta("(xref:pfam-PF13813) AND (taxonomy_id:4751) AND (length:[250 TO 600])")
acc=[k for k in sp_set if "O74380" in k][0]; ACN1=sp_set[acc]
def kmers(s,k=3): return Counter(s[i:i+k] for i in range(len(s)-k+1))
ka=kmers(ACN1)
def cos(c1,c2):
    num=sum(v*c2.get(k,0) for k,v in c1.items())
    return num/(np.sqrt(sum(v*v for v in c1.values()))*np.sqrt(sum(v*v for v in c2.values()))+1e-9)
sel=[k for _,k in sorted(((cos(ka,kmers(s)),k) for k,s in fu_set.items() if k!=acc),reverse=True)[:45]]
targets={k:sp_set[k] for k in sp_set if k!=acc}; targets.update({k:fu_set[k] for k in sel})
L=len(ACN1); ident=np.zeros(L); cov=np.zeros(L)
for k,s in targets.items():
    mp=align(ACN1,s)
    for a,b in mp.items():
        if 0<=a<L and b>=0:
            cov[a]+=1
            if ACN1[a]==s[b]: ident[a]+=1
consv=ident/len(targets)
dom=np.arange(227,304)  # PF13813 228-304 (0-based 227..303)
r287=(consv<consv[286]).mean()*100; r250=(consv<consv[249]).mean()*100
rd287=(consv[dom]<consv[286]).mean()*100; rd250=(consv[dom]<consv[249]).mean()*100
print(f"n targets={len(targets)}  mean identity-conservation={consv.mean():.3f}")
print(f"H287 conservation={consv[286]:.3f}  percentile vs full protein={r287:.1f}  vs PF13813 domain={rd287:.1f}")
print(f"H250 conservation={consv[249]:.3f}  percentile vs full protein={r250:.1f}  vs PF13813 domain={rd250:.1f}")
top=np.argsort(-consv)[:12]
print("12 most conserved acn1 positions:", ", ".join(f"{ACN1[i]}{i+1}({consv[i]:.2f})" for i in sorted(top)))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[2,1.1]})
ax[0].fill_between(np.arange(1,L+1),consv,color="#95a5a6",lw=0)
ax[0].axvspan(228,304,color="#f1c40f",alpha=.18,lw=0)
for pos,c in [(250,"#2a7fb8"),(287,"#c0392b")]:
    ax[0].axvline(pos,color=c,lw=1.3)
    ax[0].annotate(f"H{pos}\n{consv[pos-1]:.2f}",xy=(pos,consv[pos-1]),xytext=(pos,0.93),
                   ha='center',fontsize=10,color=c,arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color=c,lw=1))
ax[0].set_xlim(1,L); ax[0].set_ylim(0,1.05)
ax[0].set_xlabel("acn1 residue position (O74380, 357 aa)"); ax[0].set_ylabel("fraction identical\nin 45 PF13813 homologs")
ax[0].set_title("A. Per-residue conservation of acn1 against 45 fungal wax-synthase-domain proteins\n(yellow band: PF13813 domain 228-304)",fontsize=11,loc='left')
for s_ in ['top','right']: ax[0].spines[s_].set_visible(False)

names=["acn1 S. pombe","S. osmophilus","S. cryophilus","S. octosporus","PORCN human","DltB S. thermophilus","DGAT1 human","SOAT1 human"]
ctx=["SALFHDFA","SGLYHDFA","SGLYHDFA","SGLYHDFA","SALLHGFS","MGFWHGIT","SIAYHAFH","SAVLHEYI"]
num=["H287","H280","H281","H280","H341","H336","H415","H460"]
ax[1].axis('off')
ax[1].set_title("B. Sequence context of the invariant MBOAT histidine",fontsize=11,loc='left')
for r,(nm,c,hn) in enumerate(zip(names,ctx,num)):
    ax[1].text(0.01,0.88-r*0.115,nm,fontsize=10,va='center',transform=ax[1].transAxes)
    for ci,ch in enumerate(c):
        col="#c0392b" if ci==4 else ("#2c3e50" if ch==ctx[0][ci] else "#95a5a6")
        w="bold" if ci==4 else "normal"
        ax[1].text(0.30+ci*0.032,0.88-r*0.115,ch,fontsize=11,family="monospace",color=col,weight=w,
                   ha='center',va='center',transform=ax[1].transAxes)
    ax[1].text(0.58,0.88-r*0.115,hn,fontsize=10,color="#c0392b",va='center',transform=ax[1].transAxes)
ax[1].text(0.72,0.50,"41 of 45 fungal homologs\nkeep H at the acn1 H287 position\n38 of 45 keep H at H250",
           fontsize=10,va='center',transform=ax[1].transAxes,
           bbox=dict(boxstyle="round",fc="#fdf3e3",ec="#e0b060"))
